title: Stereo Program EQ
notes: Document's table lists 10 parameters per side but its signature has 11 letters per side ('iffifffifii'). The missing one is a low-frequency attenuation control: X32-Edit 4.4 labels the P1A controls On, Gain, LoBoost, LoFreq, LoAtten, HiWidth, HiBoost, HiFreq, HiAtten, HiAttenF, Transf, and placing LoAtten (f) after Lo Freq (i) is the only insertion that makes the listed types match the signature. 'Lo Atten' name and linf [0...10] range are INFERRED (by analogy with Lo Boost), not from the document; all later par numbers are therefore one higher than the document prints. Lo Freq enum '0, 30, 60, 100' kept as written (the hardware original is 20/30/60/100 Hz, so '0' may be a typo).
